summary: First-finish smoke test for Turkish cash flow app (Nakit Akış). Backend auth, CRUD, dashboard, and CSV export verified via Bearer session. Frontend authenticated flow verified via session cookie: login page, unauth redirect, dashboard KPIs+charts, add bank account, checks page, logout redirect. Core happy path works end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/auth/me -> 401 without auth; 200 with Bearer session token returns user
GET /api/dashboard/summary -> 200 with total_balance, monthly (6 months, Turkish month labels), categories, upcoming, month_income/expense
POST /api/checks -> 200 (fields: type, party, amount, due_date, status)
GET /api/export/{checks,promissory-notes,expenses,incomes} -> 200 with Content-Type text/csv and proper header row
Authenticated /dashboard shows dashboard-page, kpi-total-balance (₺15.000,00), kpi-upcoming-in, kpi-upcoming-out, kpi-month-net, user-name in sidebar
Monthly chart (Son 6 Ay) and categories chart render
Bank Accounts: add-account-btn opens dialog; save-account-btn creates record and row 'UI Test Hesap' is visible
Checks page loads with add-check-btn and export-checks-btn visible
logout-button clears session and redirects to /login

notes.test_credentials_file: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (expected for OAuth-only app). Test session created via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md.
notes.backend_field_conventions: Income uses 'source' (not 'category'); PromissoryNote type is 'received'/'issued' (not receivable/payable). Frontend forms send correct fields — verified against Incomes.jsx and PromissoryNotes.jsx.
not_tested_deferred_to_full_qa: Expenses total updates and Incomes total updates
Upcoming Payments page grouping by month + net totals
CSV download click via export-*-btn in UI
user_id isolation across two different users
